text: FIX a non-incremental write (`patch()`, `modify()`, `update()`, `remove()`) on an outdated `RxDocument` instance overwrote a new document with the old data when the old document was removed, purged by `cleanup()` and inserted again with the same primary key. The new document starts again at the first revision, so the conflict check of the storages now also compares `_meta.lwt` and the write throws a `CONFLICT` error
